Axios Pro Exclusive Content

Venture CapitalWarp Sciences, a Cambridge, Mass.-based chemistry CRO, raised $215m. Lightspeed led, joined by Premji Invest, Mayfield, IVP, Lux, Conviction, Menlo Ventures, 01 Advisors, Standard, Lowercarbon Capital, Gigascale Capital, Angular Ventures, Scribble Ventures, Uncork Capital, Innovation Endeavors, Matter VP, Zero Shot Fund, SignalFire, and Moxxie Ventures. Go deeper

p: 매사추세츠주 케임브리지에 소재한 화학 CRO인 Venture CapitalWarp Sciences는 2억 1500만 달러를 모금했다. Lightspeed가 주도하고 Premji Invest, Mayfield, IVP, Lux, Conviction, Menlo Ventures, 01 Advisors, Standard, Lowercarbon Capital, Gigascale Capital, Angular Ventures, Scribble Ventures, Uncork Capital, Innovation Endeavors, Matter VP, Zero Shot Fund, SignalFire 및 Moxxie Ventures가 합류했다. 더 깊이 들어가세요
